d: Swiss Rose is looking for a Marketing & Content Coordinator to create clear, engaging content for our flowers, chocolates and gifts. Working on-site with our team in West Abu Fatira Al-Herafiya, Kuwait, you will turn everyday products, arrangements and shop activities into content that helps customers discover our business, understand our products and make enquiries. Applications are welcome from all genders. RESPONSIBILITIES
Photograph products and floral arrangements, paying attention to lighting, colour, backgrounds and presentation.
Film and edit short videos, Reels and behind-the-scenes content for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
Write clear Arabic captions, product stories and promotional copy, with working English for bilingual content and team communication.
Maintain a practical content calendar covering products, occasions, launches and approved promotions.
Prepare content for review, make requested changes and publish or schedule posts after approval.
Keep photography, video, wording and visual presentation consistent with Swiss Rose's brand.
Coordinate with florists and the shop team to plan shoots and confirm product names, prices, availability and delivery information before publication.
Maintain an organised library of photos, videos, captions and approved creative materials.

Track useful results, including website visits, enquiries and attributable orders where data is available. Summarise what worked and suggest improvements, distinguishing these results from reach and views.
Confirm permission before publishing identifiable customers or staff, and use music, images and other materials with appropriate usage rights.

Use computers, spreadsheets and suitable photography, editing and scheduling tools to organise work and produce simple reports. ROLE COORDINATION This role owns content production and marketing reporting. Reception/customer service handles the primary inbox, customer follow-up and order management. Coordinate enquiries with that colleague. Paid advertising, campaign spending and budget changes require management approval. HOW TO APPLY Apply through the Swiss Rose website CV/application form. Include portfolio, social media work, or sample photo/video links in your CV or introduction, and explain your contribution to each example. Only share work you have permission to share. Mention your availability to start. Salary, work schedule and other employment terms will be discussed during recruitment.
Registered Nurse - All Specialties | European-Trained Nurses | International Recruitment Only | Relocation Opportunity to Saudi Arabia
Green Barns Health is recruiting qualified nurses across all specialties for opportunities in hospitals and healthcare clusters throughout Saudi Arabia.

For this campaign, we can only support nurses who completed their nursing training and obtained their nursing qualification in Europe. Applicants must currently live outside Saudi Arabia and be interested in relocating. Currently working in Europe alone does not meet this training requirement.
Whether your experience is in general nursing, emergency care, intensive care, theatres, paediatrics, neonatal care, oncology or another clinical specialty, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Appointments are available across multiple hospitals and locations. Your experience, clinical interests and preferences will help us identify suitable opportunities. The specific hospital, department, duties and working arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment and interview process.
Indicative salary of SAR 8,000 - 16,000 per month, depending on the position, qualifications, experience and employing hospital.
Accommodation provided. This may be shared or individual, depending on the hospital.
Annual return flight for the nurse.
Working schedule of 48 hours per week, with shift arrangements determined by the hospital.

These are single-status contracts, meaning the package is for the nurse and does not include accompanying-family benefits. Final salary, benefits and employment terms will be confirmed in the written offer.
Hold a European bachelor’s degree or diploma in nursing.
Have at least one year of nursing experience.
Hold current professional nursing registration or a licence to practise, as applicable in your country.
Communicate in English at a professional working level.
Be willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.
Meet the qualification verification and Saudi professional licensing requirements applicable to the appointment.
Applications are welcome across all nursing specialties. Please clearly state your current specialty and recent clinical experience in your CV.
Apply with an up-to-date CV in English, including
Your nursing qualification and graduation date.
Employment history, including hospital names, departments and dates.
Notice period and earliest potential start date.

Our recruitment team will review your application and contact suitable candidates for an introductory conversation. We will explain the supporting documents required and guide you through the next steps before any submission to the client.
There are no recruitment fees payable to Green Barns Health by candidates. We will obtain your written authority before presenting your profile to the client.

Green Barns Health is a UK recruitment business supporting healthcare professionals exploring opportunities in Saudi Arabia. Our recruitment leadership includes a Riyadh-based Director of Recruitment, providing local insight throughout the process.
